summary: Infinity Group's internal AI transformation as a Business Central partner: consolidating data, automating workflows such as supplier invoicing, and the advice it gives other partners. A 2-minute customer story, not a feature demo.
overview:
Infinity Group describes how it became an AI-first organization by going through the transformation itself first, as "customer zero". The program touched every part of the organization. Departments became change agents and teams got capacity back.

The speaker says AI adoption required consolidating data from separate systems into one place. Workflows were automated, including supplier invoicing, so the team could focus on strategic work. The video closes with three pieces of advice for partners: understand business challenges and find bottlenecks, get data sorted out, and take people along on the journey. The speaker also says the company went from local IT provider to global Business Central partner of the year in three years.
key_points: Infinity Group ran its own AI transformation first (the "customer zero" journey) before delivering AI to customers.
Data from disparate systems was consolidated into one place to enable AI.
Workflows were automated, including supplier invoicing, which freed the team for strategic initiatives.
The speaker says this allowed 40% growth over the last year with the same headcount as 2 years ago.
Partner advice 1: understand your business challenges, talk to your teams, find the bottlenecks.
Partner advice 2: get your data sorted out; the speaker says its importance cannot be underestimated.
Partner advice 3: take people with you on the transformation journey; they may feel threatened, so make them feel empowered.
